description: Reformat NUMBER(s), or the numbers from standard input if none are specified.

option.name: --delimiter
tip: use X instead of whitespace for field delimiter

option.name: --field
tip: replace the numbers in these input fields (default=1); see FIELDS below

option.name: --format
tip: use printf style floating-point FORMAT; see FORMAT below for details

option.name: --from
tip: auto-scale input numbers to UNITs; default is 'none'; see UNIT below

option.name: --from-unit
tip: specify the input unit size (instead of the default 1)

option.name: --grouping
tip: use locale-defined grouping of digits, e.g. 1,000,000 (which means it has no effect in the C/POSIX locale)

option.name: --header
tip: print (without converting) the first N header lines; N defaults to 1 if not specified

option.name: --invalid
tip: failure mode for invalid numbers: MODE can be: abort (default), fail, warn, ignore

option.name: --padding
tip: pad the output to N characters; positive N will right-align; negative N will left-align; padding is ignored if the output is wider than N; the default is to automatically pad if a whitespace is found

option.name: --round
tip: use METHOD for rounding when scaling; METHOD can be: up, down, from-zero (default), towards-zero, nearest

option.name: --suffix
tip: add SUFFIX to output numbers, and accept optional SUFFIX in input numbers

option.name: --to
tip: auto-scale output numbers to UNITs; see UNIT below

option.name: --to-unit
tip: the output unit size (instead of the default 1)

option.name: --zero-terminated
tip: line delimiter is NUL, not newline
